digest.component_or_area: Jira DC outbound parent field handling and Epic Link path
propositions: The outbound parent-CLEAR test can be re-homed to the Epic Link path because _resolve_local_parent returns (True, None) for detached tickets regardless of parent type, and DC's get_parent_map falls back to Epic Link
Whether {epic_link_field_id: None} actually clears on DC 8.17.1 is untested and must be verified by probe before the test cell is written
The probe's first run failed at setup with undiagnosable error messages because evidence was discarded on SystemExit and diagnostic context was missing from the output
The set_parent non-sub-task branch lacks read-back verification unlike the sub-task branch, making silent no-ops invisible if Epic Link clear silently fails
test_outbound_set_subtask_parent_round_trips should be marked xfail(strict=True) because the platform limitation is now understood as a different problem than the outbound clear case
